agent_answered.text: "Fair catch, and you've got the record right. At frost the stick should say 'kept, by the calendar,' not 'kept, by the jarl.' They aren't the same thing even when the pigs end up the same. If the jarl chose to keep them, the barley shortfall is his call and he answers for it at the spring reckoning. If the calendar chose, the shortfall is a hole in how we asked, and the fix is on me ... 's worth something, but I wouldn't write his name next to it. I'd cut it as 'no answer by frost, default held,' and if that line shows up three winters running, the trouble isn't the pigs." [5e39d76e]
